Multiple headings create multiple Heading nodes with correct levels

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Main Title</h1><h2>Section One</h2><p>Section one content.</p><h2>Section Two</h2><p>Section two content.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.document.nodes.inspect
```
